shellset_thermodynamic_requirements.evidence_basis: ShellSet v1.1 paper §2.1 and the SHELLS/OrbData archive index and author response. Paper: nodal surface elevations, crust and mantle-lithosphere thicknesses, densities, and parameters defining internal temperatures. FEG archive: nodal elevation, heat-flow, crust thickness and mantle-lithosphere thickness. Author response: ambient temperature depends on depth, local heat-flow, layer radioactive heat production and transient geotherm component; OrbData computes heat-flow and non-steady components and adds a chemical-origin lithospheric density anomaly for isostatic adjustment.

directly_documented_nodal_feg_fields.role: thermal input/OrbData-derived field in selected workflow
layer geometry input or OrbData result
layer geometry input or OrbData result

density_and_temperature_semantics.temperature: Ambient temperature is determined in SHELLS/OrbData structure from depth/topography, heat flow, layer heat production and transient geotherm curvature; the reviewed FEG descriptions do not show a mandatory standalone temperature raster.
density_and_temperature_semantics.density: Density varies thermally and through a chemical-origin anomaly. OrbData adds/adjusts a nodal chemical density anomaly for local isostasy. ShellSet checks the mean crust density is less than mean mantle density. This is not evidence that a complete absolute crust/mantle density raster is a direct required FEG column.
density_and_temperature_semantics.mean_layer_density: Crustal and mantle mean density/model parameters are consumed by ShellSet's lithosphere model and validation; exact parser/data-file parameter contract must be pinned before adapter work.

minimal_outputs_for_shellset: crust and mantle-lithosphere thickness fields or accepted OrbData path
nodal chemical density anomaly where the selected OrbData path uses it
thermal structure controlled by OrbData parameters
shellset_thermodynamic_requirements.qualification: No claim here that the exact FEG parser contract or direct ingestion of BurnMan/Perple_X products has been validated. ShellSet runtime remains unauthorized.

bulk_chemical_composition.description: Bulk oxide/component composition suitable for phase equilibrium; least phase-prescriptive input to Perple_X.
bulk_chemical_composition.authorial_burden: Composition component set and layer scope must be defined; values are not selected.

mineral_assemblage_and_endmember_fractio.description: Specified mineral/endmember/solution assemblage for thermoelastic evaluation.
mineral_assemblage_and_endmember_fractio.authorial_burden: More detailed authorial ontology; use only if ARCANA intentionally prescribes assemblage rather than equilibrium from bulk chemistry.

material_family_identifier.description: ARCANA stable ID mapping to a versioned specialist composition/model/database record, with no duplicated EOS parameter set unless required by the provider.
material_family_identifier.authorial_burden: Must resolve to a documented component basis, layer role, data/model identity and version/hash.

rock_type_label.description: Descriptive label alone does not provide composition or EOS inputs.

mechanical_material_class.description: ShellSet grouping/configuration concept; does not itself specify chemical composition or mineral physics.

layer_mapping.decision: Keep two role-specific material references. They may reference the same material-family ID only if separately authorized; this stage assumes neither shared nor distinct composition.

burnman_capability.version_documentation_basis: Stable BurnMan 2.1.0 documentation and the current online 3.0.0a0 docs; no ARCANA runtime installation or execution.
burnman_capability.role: Python mineral-physics and thermodynamic property toolkit for specified minerals, solid solutions, composites and layered 1-D planetary structures.
required_inputs: Pressure and temperature or a documented Layer/Planet profile setup
outputs: thermodynamic properties and velocities where supported
burnman_capability.phase_equilibrium_support: Yes, equilibrate tools exist for configured assemblages/constraints; documentation cautions that equilibrium is a distinct configured workflow and some tools are experimental. Not required if material assemblage is supplied or Perple_X table provides equilibrium properties.
burnman_capability.equation_of_state_support: Yes; multiple mineral EOS classes and solution/composite material models. Property validity is conditional on chosen dataset/EOS and its calibrated domain.
burnman_capability.density_support: Yes, for material at a state or from a Layer/Planet profile.
burnman_capability.self_consistent_pressure_support: Layer: yes within a spherical layer if user provides pressure at its top and gravity at its bottom. Planet: yes as part of full layered radial structure.
burnman_capability.self_consistent_gravity_support: Planet calculates radial gravity from density for a whole layered planet; Layer requires bottom gravity as input and does not close global gravity.
burnman_capability.self_consistent_density_support: Yes coupled within Planet radial self-consistency; only local pressure-density equilibrium in a Layer with externally supplied boundary pressure/gravity.
burnman_capability.temperature_support: User-defined temperature profile, adiabatic or perturbed adiabatic Layer/Planet modes; Geotherm classes provide profiles. User-defined mode requires temperatures at layer radii. Published geotherms are literature/Earth reference models; adiabatic relation is generic physics but still needs material and anchor conditions.
burnman_capability.material_database: BurnMan includes literature datasets (examples include Holland-Powell and Stixrude-Lithgow-Bertelloni families); exact dataset is a scientific model choice, with validity and attribution/license tracked per selected dataset.
burnman_capability.batchability: Python orchestration can batch points/profiles; Planet builds layered radial profiles. No execution/performance qualification performed.
burnman_capability.python_api_suitability: High for adapters and repeatable tabular evaluation, subject to pinned version and dependency environment.
burnman_capability.runtime_complexity: Python package with NumPy/SciPy and related dependencies; EOS and optional equilibrium workload varies. Pin exact release and environment.
burnman_capability.license: GNU GPL v2 or later for BurnMan software. Dataset/source citations and any separate data terms must be reviewed independently.
burnman_capability.adapter_burden: Medium for prescribed material properties at P/T; high for ShellSet mapping. Perple_X tables can be consumed by BurnMan PerplexMaterial, but ShellSet's density/anomaly/geotherm semantics still need a validated crosswalk.
scientific_limitations: Layer/Planet are radial/layered models and do not solve laterally varying shell gravity-pressure-density self-consistency.
Layer requires boundary pressure and gravity; Planet requires full radial layer structure and per-layer material/thermal definitions.
No generic synthetic-world lithospheric geotherm is selected; literature geotherms are not silently transferable.
EOS and mineral data regimes are model-specific.
burnman_capability.candidate_disposition: Use BurnMan as property evaluator if ARCANA authoritatively supplies assemblage, or as radial global reference solver only if a full radial model is later authorized. Not a demonstrated closure for laterally varying ARCANA ShellSet columns.

perplex_capability.version_documentation_basis: Current official installation documentation identifies Perple_X 7.2.6 documentation; release instructions and datafiles/solution-model files audited. Versioned release and database must be pinned before later use.
perplex_capability.role: Bulk-composition phase-equilibrium petrology, P-T sections and aggregate rock-property evaluation.
required_inputs: Bulk composition in components represented by the selected thermodynamic database
Thermodynamic data and compatible solution models
outputs: Volume/enthalpy/heat capacity and properties supported by the selected data file; shear/seismic properties only when database contains necessary data
perplex_capability.phase_equilibrium_support: Yes; VERTEX phase-equilibrium calculations/minimization with chosen endmember data and solution models.
perplex_capability.equation_of_state_support: Yes, via selected thermodynamic data/EOS parameterization; properties model/database dependent.
perplex_capability.density_support: Yes; official docs give aggregate bulk density at the evaluated reference conditions and WERAMI properties/tables across P-T grids.
perplex_capability.self_consistent_pressure_support: No documented planetary hydrostatic P-rho-g solver in audited Perple_X workflow; P/T are calculation conditions/axes.
perplex_capability.self_consistent_gravity_support: No documented gravity-profile closure in audited workflow.
perplex_capability.self_consistent_density_support: Calculates density for given P-T and equilibrium/material model; no coupled planetary pressure/gravity iteration documented.
perplex_capability.temperature_support: Consumes prescribed T or P-T section; does not provide ARCANA lithospheric thermal initialization/geotherm authority.
perplex_capability.material_database: Release bundles datafiles and solution-model files, but choice remains explicit. Thermodynamic dataset and solution model provenance, version and hash are required; coverage is only that supported by selected data/model.
perplex_capability.batchability: Command-line Fortran suite with project/configuration and batch-friendly file outputs; generate repeatable WERAMI tables after a model is defined.
perplex_capability.python_api_suitability: No official native Python API identified. Third-party wrappers exist but are not required or selected. BurnMan 2.1 PerplexMaterial can consume a standard 2-D WERAMI tab property table; this is a format adapter for tabulated properties, not implicit equivalence of all phase semantics.
perplex_capability.runtime_complexity: Fortran executables provided for Linux/macOS/Windows; release package bundles executables/data/options. Project data, options and outputs must be pinned and kept with provenance.
perplex_capability.license: Copyright is identified to James A. D. Connolly in official materials; a clear OSI/SPDX license grant was not established by the reviewed official installation/data pages. Verify current release terms before integration or redistribution.
perplex_capability.adapter_burden: Medium/high: configure component basis/database/solution models; parse/retain phase and bulk-property output; map only required properties to ARCANA/ShellSet units/support. No ShellSet direct adapter demonstrated.
scientific_limitations: Results depend on bulk component basis, database, solution models, saturation constraints and P-T range.
Not a tectonic-process classifier or thermal evolution model.
Elastic/shear outputs are not guaranteed if required endmember data are absent.
perplex_capability.candidate_disposition: Sufficient capability for bulk chemistry to equilibrium phase fractions and density at prescribed P-T; cannot alone close ARCANA pressure and lateral ShellSet mapping.

specialist_role_adjudication.decision: For a minimal authorial material ontology, prefer layer-scoped material-family IDs resolving to bulk composition on a pinned Perple_X component/database basis; Perple_X can derive equilibrium phase state and density at supplied P-T. Do not add BurnMan automatically: Perple_X already reports density and useful bulk properties. If ARCANA instead authorially supplies a mineral assemblage and wants additional properties unavailable in selected Perple_X outputs, BurnMan is the alternate/supplemental evaluator.
specialist_role_adjudication.phase_equilibrium_owner: Perple_X if equilibrium phase assemblage from bulk chemistry is selected; otherwise the assemblage is an authorial primitive and BurnMan evaluates its properties.
specialist_role_adjudication.density_owner: Perple_X at prescribed P-T in the least-prescriptive bulk-composition path; BurnMan for explicit assemblages or a 1-D Planet profile. ARCANA stores derived results with provenance, not an independent density primitive.
specialist_role_adjudication.unresolved: P-T/pressure state and spatial support applicability remain unbound; ShellSet adapter/output meaning not validated.

pressure_path.shellset_direct_pressure_input: No direct pressure or gravity FEG field is documented in reviewed ShellSet paper/archive material. Pressure is needed by the external mineral thermodynamic calculation if EOS density is to be derived.

pressure_path.arcana_applicability: NO_VALIDATED_FULL_CLOSURE_FOR_LATERALLY_VARIABLE_SHELLSET_DOMAIN. ARCANA's current T0 partition is lateral surface geometry/topology and does not define complete radial interior layers or a canonical whole-planet thermal/compositional structure. Replicating independent 1-D BurnMan columns would not be justified as global gravity self-consistency.
pressure_path.pressure_owner: BurnMan Planet can own global radial self-consistency if a complete radial world model is separately authorized. For ARCANA's laterally varying lithospheric ShellSet state, no pressure/gravity owner is currently bound.

pressure_density_coupling.burnman_planet_closes: Yes, for a fully specified spherical radial layered planet; it iterates coupled pressure/density/gravity with layered materials and thermal modes.
pressure_density_coupling.burnman_layer_closes: Only pressure-density inside a layer conditional on supplied top pressure and bottom gravity; not global gravity.

temperature_path.authorial_primitive_minimum: One T0 thermal initialization model/profile definition with explicitly scoped layer inputs; do not author separate temperature, heat-flow and density rasters where the pinned OrbData/specialist path derives them.

vertical_support.shellset: Surface-node/layer representation with crust and mantle-lithosphere thickness and temperatures varying with depth; exact internal Shells sample support is version/FEG-contract dependent.
vertical_support.burnman: Layer/Planet accept spherical radii arrays and return properties on those radial samples; interpolation at queried radii is documented.
vertical_support.perplex: Point calculations, P-T sections/grids or tabulated P-T property grids; a selected path needs defined resolution and interpolation bounds.
vertical_support.adapter_gap: VERTICAL_DISCRETIZATION_ADAPTER_GAP__OPEN: no common depth/radius datum, layer boundaries, sampling or interpolation contract selected.
vertical_support.coordinate_convention: Must document planet radius/depth datum, positive direction, crust/mantle layer boundary and units before integration.
vertical_support.averaging: No layer averaging or conservative projection method selected.

lateral_support.shellset: FEG nodal heat-flow, elevation and thickness support; material/density outputs must preserve authorized regional/layer variation.
lateral_support.burnman_planet: Global radial/layered reference only; no lateral material/gravity solution.
lateral_support.burnman_layer: One radial spherical shell; distinct regional invocations do not constitute a globally coupled lateral solution.
lateral_support.perplex: Can tabulate properties by material family over P-T; lateral application is by the caller assigning families/material maps, not Perple_X geography.
lateral_support.minimum_arcana_mapping: Two consumer layer roles (crust, mantle lithosphere), each mapped to an authorized material-family ID; a shared ID is permitted only by explicit choice. Lateral variation must not exceed material authority resolution.

density_authority.candidate_provider: Perple_X for equilibrium bulk-composition density at supplied P-T; BurnMan for specified mineral material or radial coupled reference profile.
density_authority.shellset_native_density_role: ShellSet/OrbData computes thermal density response through its geotherm/material parameterization and adds/adjusts a nodal chemical-origin density anomaly in its isostatic workflow. External absolute EOS density is not documented as directly interchangeable with this anomaly.
density_authority.adapter_status: UNRESOLVED_SEMANTIC_CROSSWALK: absolute material density/reference state to ShellSet layer mean density and nodal chemical anomaly; exact baseline/reference density conventions must be taken from pinned ShellSet/OrbData source and inputs.

remaining_gaps: No documented existing specialist closes self-consistent P-rho-g for ARCANA's laterally varying lithospheric material state; BurnMan closes only a fully specified global radial model or conditional Layer profile.
Temperature/thermal primitive and per-layer inputs remain unselected; Earth-reference geotherms may not be silently reused.
Material-family definitions, component basis and crust/mantle role assignments remain authorial and unpopulated.
ShellSet OrbData/SHELLS density convention crosswalk (absolute layer density versus reference/chemical anomaly), parser contract and provenance adapter remain unresolved.
Vertical/radial and lateral support, interpolation, averaging, and FEG mapping remain unresolved.
Perple_X release/data usage terms and selected database license/provenance require verification before integration.
next_stage: Target only the pressure-coupling and ShellSet density-semantics question. Establish whether the authorized ARCANA model can use a global radial BurnMan reference as a declared approximation, or identify a mature existing specialist that closes laterally varying pressure/gravity. In parallel pin the OrbData/SHELLS density/geotherm input contract from source. Do not implement an ARCANA iteration or execute a scientific engine.
